title: Which One? 常常 vs 经常, 会 / 能 / 可以 (B1), 次 vs 遍
description: More B1 look-alikes: how to negate 'often', three kinds of 'can' in harder contexts, and counting times.

points.title: 常常 vs 经常
points.summary: Both mean 'often'. Negative: 不常 (not ~~不常常~~). 经常 can also be an adjective: 经常的 (frequent).
points.body:
- 我**不常**去.
- 这是**经常**的事.

points.title: 会 / 能 / 可以 at B1
points.summary: 会 = likely, will (天黑了，会下雨). 能 = able (physically / circumstances: 我感冒了，不能来). 可以 = allowed, or a suggestion (你可以试试).
points.body:
- 一会儿**会**下雨.
- 我感冒了，明天不**能**来上课了.
- 你**可以**试试这件.

points.title: 次 vs 遍
points.summary: 次 = an occurrence (go, visit, meet). 遍 = once through from start to finish (read, listen, say). Places and visits only take 次.
points.body:
- 我去过三**次**上海.
- 请再说一**遍**.
examples: I've been to Shanghai three times.

notes: The negative is 不常, not 不常常.

questions.prompt: {别|bié}{担心|dānxīn}，{这|zhè}{是|shì}（　）{的|de}{问题|wèntí}，{很|hěn}{容易|róngyì}{解决|jiějué}。
notes: 常常 is only an adverb — no 常常的.
questions.translation: Don't worry, this is a common problem — easy to solve.

questions.prompt: {天|tiān}{这么|zhème}{黑|hēi}，{一会儿|yíhuìr}{可能|kěnéng}（　）{下雨|xià yǔ}。
questions.translation: It's so dark — it might rain soon.
This one's a bit small — you could try that one.

notes: 不就是 = 'isn't it just …?' — doesn't fit.
questions.translation: I've got a fever — I can't come to class tomorrow.

questions.prompt: {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{三|sān}（　）{上海|Shànghǎi}，{每|měi}{次|cì}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐhuan}。
notes: 遍 is for doing something from start to finish — not for visits.
questions.translation: I've been to Shanghai three times and loved it each time.

questions.prompt: Which word means 'once through, from beginning to end'?
